forum.content_text:
Hello,

I hope to reach the appropriate contact regarding Country of Origin (CoO) information at ST.

We have identified a conflict between the CoO listed on the website and other documents (such as PCN and the attached FMD chemical document). These documents indicate that the CoO for part **STM32H523RCT7** is **China**, while the website lists the CoO as **France**.

Could you please clarify this discrepancy and specify what the **France** CoO refers to? Based on our documents, the CoO **China** corresponds to the country of assembly.

Your clarification on this matter would be greatly appreciated.

Website CoO FRANCE : <https://www.st.com/en/microcontrollers-microprocessors/stm32h523rc.html#sample-buy>
